systems.platform: fibre optic, about 300 km; IP/MPLS core moved from Huawei to Nokia by CSquared Woezon, 100 Gbit/s; GPON
systems.owner: the State; core operated by CSquared Woezon, supervised from a network operations centre at the national data centre
systems.tiers: more than 600 public administration buildings in the city of Lomé (teaching hospitals, health centres, over a third of public lycées, universities, all institutions of the Republic and all ministries), 100 Mb/s per building; no commune office named

systems.platform: fibre optic, about 1,500 km, 24 fibres per link
systems.tiers: designed to reach all prefectures and about forty towns; SIM-based products offered to administrations in rural areas that cannot take fibre

note: Government ICT specification page (prices valid at 20 February 2023): it describes operators' internet offers for administrations and the E-Gouv government network linking over 600 public buildings in Lomé, but names no commune or town hall as connected, so it gives no fact.
